explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list; FDA's record shows actions at plants on our labels

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows insulin glargine is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The product label (SPL set 99ea856d) names Genzyme Corporation (FEI 3009389940) as a registered plant for labeling and packing, last inspected NAI on 2025-08-14.
The same label names Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH (FEI 3003195501) as a registered plant for analysis, labeling, manufacture, and packing, last inspected VAI on 2022-03-25.

FDA inspection records for Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH include an OAI classification on 2010-09-16 (known 2010-12-15) and a Warning Letter on 2011-02-08, with subsequent inspections all VAI through 2022-03-25.
Corvale East holds 94 syringes (7.4 days on hand at 12.6/day); Corvale Lakeside holds 70 syringes (26.5 days on hand at 2.6/day).
The top-ranked option is to transfer 33 syringes of 1.5 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would leave Lakeside with 14 days and bring East to 10 days.
